prompt.on: Ending rule for this video: the last beat returns to the picture of the first beat, so the replay seam is invisible. Use the hook's set (its fallback `params.set`) in the last beat, and end its camera on a `wide` key on the same subject the hook shows, at least 1 s before the end. No close-up in the last beat holds longer than 1 s. The loop line already leads back in sound; make the picture lead back too.

experiments.description: Shorts: the last beat ends on the hook's set at a wide shot, so the loop seam is invisible

result.why: QA/fact failures 18% with the change vs 0% without (guard)

prompt.on: Motion rule for this video (money-travels-not-pops): money moves, things arrive. In build beats, whenever the line says money passes from one thing to another (a customer pays the restaurant, rent goes to the landlord, a fee goes to the bank), add a `flow` action: {"at": <the word naming where it goes>, "do": "flow", "target": <source item id>, "to": <destination item id>, "n": 3-8, "text": "{figure}" (optional, a placeholder)}; notes fly on an arc from source to destination and the destination squashes as they land. At least one flow in every build beat that names money changing hands. A thing that enters because of another thing grows out of it: add "from": <that item id> to its `enter`. Other entries fly in from the nearer side of the frame by themselves. Use `shake` sparingly: it is now a hop, at most one per beat. After a flow, put a camera key (`move: true`) on the destination on the landing word.

experiments.description: Shorts: build-beat things fly in (or grow out of `from`) and land with a squash instead of popping on their spot; shake is a hop; the `flow` verb sends notes along an arc from one thing to another with the figure riding on them (remotion/src/studio/build.tsx, travel.ts)

Shorts: the cinematic bed starts on a major chord, with a soft kick on 1 and 3 and a shaker from bar 1 and a snare on 2 and 4 from bar 3 (renderer/engine/music.py _cinematic_pulse). Built 2026-11-02, waits for a free slot (maxActiveExperiments 5); set status running and startedAt to start it.

prompt.on: Ending rule for this video: Turn.tsx and Payoff.tsx are not one held picture. Give each 2-3 actions keyed to the events of the words that name them: the figure being said slams in big with its label, the thing from the last board beat comes back and grows, shrinks, breaks or fills, and a final label or chip says the point so the beat reads on mute. Nothing in the turn or payoff goes 2.5 s without something new. Choose the camera sizes and transitions of the hook, turn, payoff and loop beats so they differ from the previous Short's ending (not close-then-wide on the turn and wide on the payoff again).

experiments.description: Shorts: the coded Turn and Payoff beats act on their words (2-3 actions each, nothing held 2.5 s) and the ending's camera and transitions differ from the last video's
Shorts: a big-money format told through the viewer's own money (your savings, bonus, gold), not a named billionaire or company
